author: 3owj
content: Replaced sequential run_all() with WorkspaceScope::MultiSession. --all in resolve_scope() collects unprocessed sessions sorted by date and returns MultiSession{session_ids}. Assembly wraps all sessions' inputs (raw notes, recordings, artifacts) into one workspace. render_session_md lists each session with its inputs and a report requirement note. sources_for_scope unions sources visible for any session's course. Dry-run display lists all session IDs. One AI launch, report scope.sessions lists all IDs, update_session_status marks all processed. --for-course filters to one course's sessions.
